summary: The broker drops the socket: the manager connects again with the same query and headers and subscribes again; an OI packet before the new socket's first full packet publishes nothing.

notes: HdfcSkyFeed::on_connected clears the merge baselines, as the web's _on_ws_connect does.

deviations.reason: HDFC Sky sends lastTradeTime in epoch seconds (the web's own test pairs lastTradeTime 1700000000 with packetTimestamp 1700000000000); the web sends it unconverted as ltt, a docs key that is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it to ms (investright::trade_time_ms). Lead decision: ltt in seconds -> ms, web defect (wrong unit).
